context: A small wine bar after work. Yumiko and Yuki — colleagues at the same firm — discovered recently they're both mothers of young kids (Yuki isn't one yet, but caught up in the conversation anyway). First time meeting outside the office.
purpose: colleague friendship gelling — small revelation about shared territory

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 初めての二人飲みやね。
lines.en: First time it's just the two of us drinking together, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, easy opening that dissolves any awkwardness. Light, inclusive tone. Inviting.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ですね。ちょっと緊張してます。
lines.en: It is. I'm a bit nervous, actually.
lines.style: A small, self-aware laugh. Voice lifts slightly — vulnerability wrapped in honesty. Genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Amused, leaning in slightly. The curiosity is warm, not interrogative. Already enjoying the moment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 先輩なので、いつもオフィスで…
lines.en: Well, you're my senior at work, so it's always…
lines.style: Trails off intentionally. Doesn't finish — both of them understand the unspoken weight. Hesitant, searching.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日は普通に。私もただの飲み仲間。
lines.en: Not tonight. Tonight I'm just a drinking buddy.
lines.style: Sets down her glass on 「ただの」 with quiet intention. Real permission being given. Steady, clear.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい。…じゃあ、お子さん、二人でしたよね。
lines.en: Right. …You have two kids though, don't you?
lines.style: Soft pivot toward real conversation. A beat of gathering courage. She's been listening — she knows things.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、十歳と五歳。今日、夫が見てくれてる。
lines.en: Ten and five. My husband's with them tonight.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact comfort. The gratitude in 「見てくれてる」 is quiet and genuine. No performance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いいですね、そういうの、本当に大事。
lines.en: That's really important — that kind of thing actually matters.
lines.style: Sincere, no artifice. She means it. Thoughtful observation, not flattery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: What about you, Yuki-chan — do you have kids?
lines.style: Drops to the diminutive name. The gate opens a little wider. Gentle, genuinely curious, safe.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: いえ、まだ。…でも、大変そうですね、本当に。
lines.en: No, not yet. …But it sounds genuinely hard, honestly.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. A real observation, not sympathy. The 「本当に」 carries actual respect.
